verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill and methodology pack that runs on top of AI coding agents, so asking whether it can use tools from MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, none of the evidence documents any way to register or connect MCP servers. The browser daemon, the skills and the host configs are gstack's own tooling, and MCP support in hosts like Claude Code is a host-platform feature that earns no credit here.
